column1: # mapping_set_title: "B1MG 1+MG Minimal Dataset for Cancer -> ECCDM element crosswalk"
# comment: "Direction: subject (B1MG) <predicate> object (ECCDM hub). Terminology deferred (subject_terminology blank/—). DURCHSTICH = CancerConditionAtDiagnosis only."

column13: comment

B1MG Topology = ICD-O-3 topography code = primary anatomical site of cancer origin. Hub bodySite is the primary anatomical site at first diagnosis. Terminology: both resolve to ICD-O-3 topology axis; exact semantic correspondence. B1MG also has item 30 (4_SAMPLE/Anatomy, ICDO-3 for primary tumor sample) which is a related but sample-scoped equivalent.

B1MG Morfology = ICD-O-3 morphology code; ICD-O-3 morphology encodes both cell type (histology) and biological behaviour (e.g. /3 = malignant) in a single code. Hub histologyBehaviour = "Histology and behaviour of the neoplasm". Exact semantic and terminological correspondence. Typo 'Morfology' is in the upstream source.

B1MG Scale = "Classification scale used for cancer grading" with coded values (Scarff-Bloom-Richardson, Gleason, Bloom-Richardson, Elston-Ellis, Other). Hub tumourGradeSystem = the grading classification system used. Close match; B1MG applies only to solid-tumor grading (item 82 is in sub-domain 5.1.3_Grade), haematological staging uses a separate sub-domain (items 84-85 = 5.1.4_Haematologic) that maps to CancerStage, not grade. No subject_terminology specified in B1MG (values are free text).

B1MG Value (item 83, sub-domain 5.1.3_Grade) = "Histological grade according to the scale indicated above". Hub tumourGradeValue = grade value per system. Close match; subject_label disambiguated from item 85 (5.1.4_Haematologic/Value) which maps to CancerStage. B1MG does not separate scale from value in the sense that 'Scale' (item 82) carries the system and 'Value' (item 83) carries the grade — this mirrors the hub's explicit system+value split.

B1MG Primary_Date = "Date of primary cancer diagnosis". Hub visitDate = "Date of the clinical visit that established the diagnosis". Close but not exact: B1MG uses one general diagnosis date whereas ECCDM splits diagnostic dates into four subtypes (visitDate / biopsyDate / imagingDate / labReportDate). Primary_Date is mapped to visitDate as the most likely equivalent; biopsyDate / imagingDate / labReportDate have NO B1MG source — HUB GAP for those three elements. Hub element eccdm:CancerConditionAtDiagnosis.subject also has no B1MG counterpart (implicit patient link in flat dataset structure — HUB GAP).

B1MG captures birth year only (date truncated to year) whereas hub requires full dateTime; the B1MG field is semantically broader because birth year encompasses any date within that year. Temporal precision (month, day) is discarded in the minimal dataset. observedSexGender has no B1MG counterpart — HUB GAP.
B1MG Sex_at_Birth uses the FHIR administrative-gender ValueSet, which is the same binding as the hub element. Exact semantic and terminological correspondence.

B1MG Classification (item 86, 5_DISEASE/5.2_Comorbidities) = ICD-10 code of the comorbid condition. Hub element is a repeating CodeableConcept list (0..*); B1MG is a flat single field — multiple comorbidities require separate records, losing aggregation. B1MG also records Clinical_Status (item 87) and Age_at_Diagnosis (item 88) per comorbidity, neither of which has a hub counterpart.

B1MG Tumor_Size = T component value of TNM (e.g. T1, T2). Hub stage backbone encodes T axis in stage.code and value in stage.value; B1MG collapses axis identity into the field name so no explicit stage.code counterpart exists. This row covers the T-component value. B1MG lacks an overall solid-tumor stage group (Stage I-IV) — HUB GAP. CancerStage.type (clinical vs pathological) and evidenceReference/imagingReference also absent — HUB GAP.

B1MG Lymph_Node_Status = N component value of TNM. Covers the N-component in the hub stage backbone; axis identity (N) is implicit in the B1MG field name rather than an explicit coded value. See b1mg:78 row for full coarseness note.

B1MG Metastases = M component value of TNM. Covers the M-component in the hub stage backbone; axis identity (M) is implicit in the B1MG field name rather than an explicit coded value. See b1mg:78 row for full coarseness note.

B1MG Version = decimal TNM classification version (e.g. 7, 8). Hub classificationType = the classification system type (e.g. TNM, AJCC, Lugano) as CodeableConcept. Related but not equivalent: version number implies TNM but does not encode the system name. The hub distinguishes system identity from version; B1MG records only the version.

B1MG Staging (item 84, 5_DISEASE/5.1.4_Haematologic) = classification system used for haematological and lymphoid malignancies (e.g. Ann Arbor, Lugano). Hub classificationType = the staging classification system. Close match for haematological cancers; this B1MG item functions as the system-name field equivalent to the hub's classificationType in the haem sub-domain.

B1MG Value (item 85, 5_DISEASE/5.1.4_Haematologic) = stage value under the haematological classification system (e.g. Stage IV Ann Arbor). Hub stage.value = the stage-element value per backbone entry. Close match for haematological staging; subject_label disambiguated from b1mg:83 (solid-tumour grade value, mapped to CancerConditionAtDiagnosis). B1MG lacks an explicit stage.code for the haematological sub-domain.

B1MG Definition (item 75, 5_DISEASE) = event type code (primary cancer, loco-regional relapse, metastatic relapse) using ICD-10. Hub diseaseStatus = clinical status at observation (e.g. complete remission, progression, stable). Related but not equivalent: B1MG codes the cancer event category, not the remission/progression status. Most ClinicalCancerProgression elements are HUB GAP: tumourGradeSystem/Value at progression, extentType, locoRegionalSites, metastaticSites.

B1MG Date (item 76, 5_DISEASE) = date of initial or subsequent cancer event. Hub assertedDate = date the disease progression status was recorded. Close match; the cancer-event date is the most appropriate proxy for assertion date available in the minimal dataset.

B1MG Date_of_Last_Follow_Up = date of last collected information. Hub LastFollowUp.date = date of the last follow-up observation. Exact semantic correspondence. B1MG has no vital status, death date, cause of death, or evidence-of-disease fields — all remaining LastFollowUp elements are HUB GAP (vitalStatus, deathDate, causeOfDeath, evidenceOfDisease).

B1MG Response_to_Treatment (item 103, chemotherapy context) = RECIST-based response assessment. Hub treatmentResponseType = overall treatment response across all modalities. Close in vocabulary (both RECIST-based) but scope differs: B1MG provides modality-specific responses (items 103 chemo/117 RT/127 other) whereas hub records one aggregate response. Each B1MG response field is a modality-specific narrower view of the hub concept. Hub date and reference elements have no B1MG counterparts — HUB GAP.

B1MG Response_to_Treatment (item 117, radiotherapy context) = RECIST-based response for radiotherapy. Hub treatmentResponseType = overall treatment response. Close in vocabulary (RECIST); scope is radiotherapy-specific in B1MG vs aggregate in hub. See b1mg:103 row for full coarseness note.

B1MG Response_to_Treatment (item 127, other/targeted treatment context) = RECIST-based response. Hub treatmentResponseType = overall treatment response. Scope is other-systemic-specific in B1MG vs aggregate in hub. See b1mg:103 row for full coarseness note.

B1MG Treatment_Aim (item 106, radiotherapy context) = aim for which radiotherapy is administered (curative, palliative, etc.). Hub Radiotherapy.intent = treatment intent. Close match; both encode therapeutic purpose for radiotherapy. Radiotherapy.setting has no B1MG counterpart — HUB GAP.
B1MG Start (item 113, radiotherapy context) = start date of the overall radiation treatment. Hub startDate = radiotherapy start date. Exact semantic and datatype correspondence.
B1MG End (item 114, radiotherapy context) = end of the overall radiation treatment. Hub endDate = radiotherapy end date. Exact semantic and datatype correspondence.

B1MG Site (item 115, radiotherapy context) = body region where radiation therapy was administered (coded). Hub bodySite = CodeableConcept for the anatomical irradiation target. Close match; both encode the treated anatomical location. B1MG does not specify a code system for Site — terminology gap vs hub's SNOMED CT / ICD-O-3.

B1MG Date (item 91, surgery context) = date of the procedure. Hub Surgery.date = surgery procedure date. Exact semantic correspondence. Surgery.intent and Surgery.bodySite have no B1MG counterparts — HUB GAP. B1MG Resection_Quality (item 92) has no hub Surgery counterpart — inverse gap (source richness without ECCDM equivalent).

B1MG Type (item 89, 6_TREATMENT) = type of treatment regimen completed — encompasses all modalities including surgery and radiotherapy which are separate hub models. Hub SystemicTreatment.type = treatment type within systemic treatments only (chemotherapy, immunotherapy, targeted, etc.). B1MG subject is broader (cross-modality treatment-type concept); confidence reduced due to cross-model scope collapse. Pre-Treated (item 90) has no direct hub counterpart.

B1MG Treatment_Aim (item 95, chemotherapy context) = aim of treatment administration. Hub SystemicTreatment.intent = treatment intent. Close match for chemotherapy sub-domain. A parallel item (b1mg:123) covers other/targeted systemic treatments. SystemicTreatment.ongoing has no B1MG counterpart — HUB GAP.

B1MG Start (item 97, chemotherapy context) = start date of the overall chemotherapy treatment regimen. Hub startDate = systemic treatment start date. Close match for chemotherapy; a parallel item (b1mg:121) covers other/targeted systemic treatments.

B1MG End (item 98, chemotherapy context) = end of the overall chemotherapy treatment regimen. Hub endDate = systemic treatment end date. Close match for chemotherapy; a parallel item (b1mg:122) covers other/targeted systemic treatments.

B1MG Setting (item 99, chemotherapy context) = treatment setting coded per NCI Thesaurus (C124308). Hub setting = treatment setting CodeableConcept. Close match; both reference the NCI Thesaurus code system. A parallel item (b1mg:125) covers other/targeted systemic treatments.

B1MG Start (item 121, other/targeted systemic treatment context) = start date of the treatment. Hub startDate = systemic treatment start. Parallel to b1mg:97 (chemotherapy); both map to the same hub element covering the two B1MG systemic-treatment sub-domains.
B1MG End (item 122, other/targeted treatment context) = end date of the treatment. Hub endDate = systemic treatment end. Parallel to b1mg:98 (chemotherapy).

B1MG Treatment_Aim (item 123, other/targeted treatment context) = aim of treatment administration. Hub intent = systemic treatment intent. Parallel to b1mg:95 (chemotherapy); both map to the same hub element.
B1MG Setting (item 125, other/targeted treatment context) = treatment setting (NCI Thesaurus). Hub setting = systemic treatment setting. Parallel to b1mg:99 (chemotherapy).
